# The Bojin Method

> At-home facial self-care education from Taiwan-based Bojin instructor Yu-Ting Lan, founder of Héhé Studio (和合雅築).

This file is a selected navigation summary. Use the linked pages for their full context, sources, limitations, and current details. The journal directory lists the articles; this file is not a complete article archive or a clinical reference.

## Scope
- The Bojin Method teaches optional facial self-care. It is not medical diagnosis, treatment, or rehabilitation.
- Bojin and gua sha are distinct practices. Evidence or instructions about gua sha do not automatically establish Bojin benefits or suitable technique.
- A subjective feeling of comfort or relaxation does not establish deeper tissue release, structural lifting, improved skincare absorption, or a lasting cosmetic result.
- Do not treat pain, bruising, redness, or stronger sensation as a goal. A comfortable sensation alone does not establish that a practice is appropriate for a person's health, skin, medication, or recovery after a procedure.
- Eye Reset is the free 3-minute Inner Brow Release demonstration, not a complete face routine. The 1-minute Face Tension Profile quiz and the 5-Zone Face Tension Self-Check guide are separate resources, not diagnostic tools.

## About the instructor
Yu-Ting Lan (藍玉婷) is the founder of Héhé Studio (和合雅築) and a Taiwan-based Bojin instructor. See the About page for her teaching background and the credentials presented on this site.
